description: Get YouTube video metadata: title, channel, description, duration (text and seconds), views, likes, comment count, upload date, and tags. Unknown values are null. Served by the provider selected with YT_PROVIDER (see get_server_info). Input: YouTube URL or video ID. Errors carry a code (e.g. ACCESS_BLOCKED, VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE, TIMEOUT) in _meta["youtube-mcp/error"] and as a [CODE] text prefix.

video.description: YouTube video URL or video ID

name: get_video_info

description.description: null when YouTube did not provide a description; empty string when it is empty

duration.description: Human-readable duration, e.g. '1m 21s'; null when unknown or live

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds; null when unknown or live

uploadedAt.description: innertube provider: display text such as 'Sep 14, 2017' or 'Premiered May 27, 2020'. api provider: ISO 8601 timestamp
